messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: inference.queue.latency - P1 - page fired (eu-west + us-east) - https://pagerduty.example/incs/PD-998877

incident-bot: auto-escalation -> oncall rotation: alex-ops -> priya-sre

sara: seeing alerts too, dashboard shows sustained 99th latency ~2.1s and spike in retries 5m ago.

alex-ops: Acked, but I'm mid-shift in apac. handing to @priya-sre. Priya, want me to forward the PD incident? :arrow_right:

priya-sre: taking it. joining bridge now -> https://meet.example/bridge/3355556666 :phone:

mike-infra: FYI autoscaler didn't kick earlier. pods in queue-processor stuck at 100% CPU, OOM restarts started trending.

priya-sre: thanks. quick triage: 1) check recent deploys 2) verify caches 3) scale pool if needed. Runbook link: https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/inference-queue.md

jordan-cs: customer-impact: support ticket stream shows ~12 customers with increased 503s, one small fintech customer reporting timeouts. Not widespread but certainly user-facing.

sara: logs show repeated KVCache eviction errors from node-12 and node-15 around 10:23:14. config patch rolled at 10:20.

priya-sre: action plan: revert KV cache config change, restart queue-processor in eu-west, temporarily increase dedicated-pool size for eu-west by +2 GPUs, enable fallback route to model-compact for low-latency requests. I'll execute now.

alex-ops: if you need me to push the revert I can, but priya is on it. tagging @mike-infra for pool scale quota check.

mike-infra: quota okay, bumping pool -> executing resize command: `infractl pool resize --name dedicated-eu-west --add 2`

priya-sre: rollback KV config: `kubectl apply -f kvcache-config-v2.yaml` -> applied, restarting queue-processor pods: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/queue-processor -n inference`

incident-bot: PD note: priya-sre acknowledged incident PD-998877 at 2023-11-07T10:29:05Z

priya-sre: pods coming up, initial tail shows fewer eviction errors. 99th latency dropping to ~700ms (was 2.1s).

jordan-cs: customer update drafted, sending to affected customers: "We've identified a transient issue affecting inference latency for a subset of requests; mitigation in progress; ETA ~15m."

sara: monitoring shows retries dropping, error rate trending down. Will keep watch for 15m.

priya-sre: keeping PD incident open until stable 30m. If anything reappears we'll escalate to oncall lead. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

jordan-cs: filed customer post-incident note placeholder. will update when incident closed.

incident-bot: incident timeline event recorded -> PD-998877 -> acknowledged by priya-sre -> mitigation actions started."
